reviews.text: Very satisfied with this service. Juan 2152 and his assistant Zander did an excellent job. Juan 2152 explained the problem and everything that had to be done. I recommend him 100% on such an excellent job done. Thank you!

Roto-Rooter did an great job. They sent out a man named Juan who was super friendly and did a thorough job of clearing the clog we had in our kitchen sink. Ill definitely be contacting them next time I need a plumber

I just want to say what commendable service by the technician Juan and  very knowledgeable in his trade. Thankful for him coming out late in the night when I needed help in my first ever home. I feel a lot better owning a home now that I have a better understanding of the plumbing thanks to him on what to do and what not to do. Great service and all around great guy, Thank you!!!

Drew was very knowledgeable and patient.  I told him I wanted to learn to be able to do a water heater flush myself and he took me through every step, and showed me how to handle every snag we came across.  I appreciate that he went out of his way to do so.

We had an emergency plumbing issue at 6pm on a Sunday night...not only was the booking agent pleasant but the technician, Louis that came out, really gave it his all -- especially since it decided to pour rain when he arrived. He needed to come back the next morning and did so with extra help; Kevin. They both were very informative, patient and took extra care to make sure we got the remedy we needed. Thank you so much for helping us in this situation! It was our first time using Roto-Rooter and

Your guy arrived very quickly and was very helpful and friendly.  His name was Berkley.  What started as a potential disaster (with new weekend guests just arriving) Berkley made it go away by solving our problem quickly and efficiently. I still can’t believe it turned out so well.  Thank you very much.  David Cannon

We had water backing up into the house and Steven came out quickly to assess the problem. He determined the main line was clogged and cleared the line very quickly. He was very professional and courteous. We are very satisfied with the results of his work.
Tony was excellent. Quick service arrival and professional. Fixed my issues and cleaned up nicely! Great service would highly recommend.

Berkley was absolutely amazing and so helpful I couldn’t not recommend enough. He was prompt to arrive, began working immediately, answered all questions, and was helpful every step of the way. Will be reaching out to him for all our Roto-Rooter needs from now on!

The technician came out and identified the problem was with my water filter not being installed properly so the filter was bad and that caused the low pressure to my house. I really appreciate the effort that was put into identifying the problem and solving it for me. I would recommend them to anyone needing a plumber
Had an emergency late Saturday night and our technician Juan was there within 30 mins. He was able to fix our issue in less than an hour and made sure all water was running properly before leaving.

Amazing service!  I was out of the country and my sump pump system went out threatening a flood of our basement.  Roto Rooter was there in less than an hour and got the whole system diagnosed, replaced, tested and up and running in a couple of hours.  Bry was amazing and the entire customer experience from start (customer service request) to finish was flawless.  Thank you Roto Rooter!!
The tech that came out was very knowledgeable with great experience in fixing my issue. He had a very positive attitude and was helpful. I would recommend their service again.
Great service.  Tony worked in the dark to get my gas leak repaired so we’d have hot water and heat
Berkley did a great job. He kept me informed and took his time to get the job done right.
I had a great experience.  The tech guy Drew was quick and efficient in resolving the problem.

A technician came to my house on 6/20/25 and suggested two tankless water heater flush. He did this job for an hour and charged me $824.50. I paid the amount suspecting that it seemed too high. I called Medley company and they said the cleaning service is $150 per heater! I asked my friends how much they usually pay and they said $100 per heater. Roto-Rooter overcharged me $500 more! This is ridiculous. I contacted the customer service as well.
Stephen was friendly, clean, quick and efficient taking care of our drain issue.   I would use Roto-Rooter again.
Roto-Rooters came out on a Thursday night after 9pm when none of the toilets or showers were usable and handled things very professionally and quickly got my home back to functioning.
Very friendly yet professional.  Detailed explanations and photos to explain the issues.  I felt treated with respect.
Drew was amazing and very knowledgeable. Give him a raise. Great guy and great man
Steven was very professional and explained what steps he was taking and if any costs would be occurred.  Even though the issue could not be fixed he was provided me with next steps and expectations.

I had two issues at my house thinking maybe it was combined. Main issue was our kitchen sink and secondary issue was our bathroom sink & bathtub. My husband called and they were able to schedule some to come out soon. The 1st guy that they sent you could tell didn't want to be here. Told him the issues and showed him what was going on. Excellent customer service! Jorge explained everything in detail! I would most definitely use them again!
They came out very quickly took care of our problem very fast and found roots in pipes took care of it and was very respectful ☺️
Juan was very informative on our plumbing issues. He arrived in a timely manner.

Let me start by saying the dispatcher, drain cleaner, and the water restoration person were all exceptional.  With that being said, I was SHOCKED at the cost of service.  For 15 minutes of actual work to unplug my kitchen sink line with a clean out totally accessible my bill was right at $500.  I almost had a heart attack.  I worked in the plumbing field after retiring from the United States Air Force.  During the 18 years I worked in plumbing… this is a total rip off.  Heck, a surgeon probably

Full disclosure I was solicited for this review and  I'm completing this on initial diagnostics and not ultimate repair. Roto Rooter sent a guy out to us at 10pm and he stayed up at the gallery trying to figure out the problem until 2am. He had tried everything but still couldn’t find what was causing the problem. The very next day the same guy was up at the gallery at 8am with his supervisor and team to figure it out. Roto Rooter not o
Damon is extremely knowledgeable and arrived quickly. I am thoroughly pleased with what he did.
Kevin was great help today. He fixed my clogged toilet fast and with reasonable price. I would definitely use them again.

Roto-Rooter plumbers Dave and Tyler left my house like this after claiming that the compression nut and sleeve couldn't be removed.. I can't believe that professional plumbers have never heard of a "compression sleeve puller tool".

Today(6-21-2022), supervisor John & tradesman James came out and corrected the plumbing procedure that was initially performed by the previous technician & his apprentice last week.  John stated that going forward he would ensure that the technicians clearly explain

I want to personally thank the contractors: Darius Smith , Jorge Dehoyos, and Isaiah Ayala . They were very kind and considerate of my needs. They explained what had to be done and gave me an appropriate time frame for our plan of action. Excellent customer service! Much appreciated!
The tech was very helpful and talked about everything he was going to do and answered any questions I had.

Juan was our technician for a kitchen sink clog issue that left us without use of the kitchen for some time. We truly got lucky with his service. He was patient and understanding of our situation and walked us through our best options. Not only did he listen, but he took the time to explain the warranty and process. I highly recommend Juan and his services with Roto-Rooter.
Technician is very knowledgeable and immediately rectified the cause of issue.

Steve was absolutely the best. I greatly appreciate his clear and concise communication. He communicated the process clearly and resolved the issue in a short period of time. Many thanks to you Steve, I'd definitely recommend him for anyone looking for plumbing services in DFW

Roto-Rooter Plumbing and Water Cleanup has done an excellent job twice for our bathroom sink, toilet and kitchen sink. Jesse was timely, efficient, affordable and honest.

I had already tried two plumbers who could not complete the job, for the sink and toilet.

Jesse not only unclogged both, but identified the source for both whereas the others did not. He showed me where the weaknesses were in the kitchen sink, and exactly what had caused the issue.

He gave great advice on future prevention f

Steve, with Roto-rooter was great! He came promptly after we called roto-rooter plumbing and asked a few basic questions and got right to work. He was amicable and fixed my clogged sewer in less than an hour.   Will definitely use them again.

Price was 100% more than when I had same service 4 years ago by a local company. Workers were great, explained what they were doing and  respected my house and property.
When the sales rep came out and recommended I install another clean out I agreed even though the price appeared rather high . I wanted the job done and over with so agreed to the high price.

THE PROBLEM:  after orally telling me the price the Sales Rep or what ever his title, tells me he is going to email me a contract to sign

I can’t explain via text how livid I am. Imagine taking off work for an appointment. I’ve literally had THREE confirmed appointments within the same week, and no one calls or shows. I’ve had to call them each time to confirm that my appointment was still confirmed, which has been meet with “Sorry Mr.Anderson it looks like your appointment is actually tomorrow”. I’ll be filing a claim with the BBB shortly, and I recommend avoiding this company at all costs.

We had 2 guys come out from the Irving location for an issue with our toilet and they only wanted to talk about a service contract for my hot water heater. I said no to the contract and they never followed up on my toilet issue. A few weeks later my HWH started leaking and I'm sure they had something to do with it. They had no reason to touch it because it is in the attic, nowhere close to the bathroom.  Never calling them again!
Professional and provided step by step of what was being done.   STEVEN was excellent!

Juan did an awesome job! We called 4 different places to help with a blockage at 3pm on a Friday. No other companies would come out until Monday, but jaun did! He was at our house by 4 and done by 5. He even replaced some fitting that I broke while trying to fix it myself at no extra charge. 10/10 would recommend.

Excellent experience with Roto- Rooter and Jesse the plumber!! On time, really friendly, got us back in business quickly and made sure everything was working properly before he left. I will call on you again! Thanks for helping us out.

Called roto rooter plano and they had a technician out in less than an hour. Cleared the clog through the clean out efficiently and even brought out a camera tech to verify clear pipes.  We had contacted other plumbers earlier in the week who didn’t fix it and wanted to charge us double for pulling the toilet to fix the problem, which was not needed. Thank you Steven and roto rooter. Reasonable, professional and efficient

I know RotoRooter is not cheap, but everytime we had an emergency, we called them and they never disappoint. They always resolved the problem, when others failed, and their service has always been top notch. Their techs know what they are doing, and were always helpful diagnosing the root cause of the problems. Of course their punctuality and their friendly and professional attitude is a plus!  Sergio took care of our latest problem. He arrived earlier than we expected, he was really friendly, a
Deyoung was great to work with, did the work quickly and gave us good tips for future maintenance.

My plumbing emergency was handled quickly and efficiently. The technician was prompt, courteous and knowledgeable. They actually made it quite easy to laugh about an otherwise messy situation. Great employees and technicians make great companies. I am a very happy customer.

Drew did an amazing job! I called roto rooter for a leaky bathroom faucet, Drew came out, thoroughly explained the process and costs and fixed the issue. Highly recommend. He was also able to accommodate my schedule when I had to leave for work. Very professional.
